text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
『—So please, don't worry about me. Just 
stay over at your family's estate tonight 
and spend time with everyone, Ruby』

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
『Even if I'm feeling a bit unwell, it's 
just the usual... I'll get better if I 
sleep it off』

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Miracle-san. However—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
『...Sorry, I'm getting kind of sleepy. 
I'll text you on LANE again... See you 
tomorrow, Ruby』

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
...My Lady. Shall you be staying here 
tonight, then?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Yes, please arrange it so.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I ended that call pretty abruptly, 
didn't I? I'm sorry, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I can't convey it... Even 
though I can't tell you the truth. 
Instead, I'll send you countless apologies 
in my heart. —I'm sorry, Ruby.)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry. Just like you, everyone around 
me is so kind. Everyone is filled with 
nothing but kindness, it's just that—)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...When people are too kind to me.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm... just not very good at handling it.

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Kay-chan, how are you feeling? Do you 
think you can take your medicine? ...Is it 
still too hard to sit up?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Your fever went up a little bit. But don't 
worry, everyone is right here with you! 
We'll call your parents too—

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...P-Please don't call them.

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Kay-chan?

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: ............Can we please not tell them?

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mom and Dad... Even if they're sleeping, 
or working, or super tired, they always 
come right away. ...They always rush over.

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please don't tell Dad or Mom. Is it bad... 
if we don't tell them—?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, what a fitting dream for today.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm not good at receiving too much 
kindness. Or being on the receiving end of 
things.)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(There really isn't anything that everyone 
ought to be doing for me.)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
After all... ...just by being here like 
this, I've already received countless 
miracles from everyone.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
From here on, every single day, anytime, 
all I have to do is return it with 'thank 
you'.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...That is enough. I don't need anything 
else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning. Heading towards the 
school gates, I saw Daiichi Ruby standing 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curious about her rigid, somewhat tense 
stance as she stood motionless, I called 
out with a greeting. Whereupon—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby walked away. Didn't she have 
business standing there in the first 
place?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to ask, however, I could only watch 
her retreating back...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Ruby! Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ... ...How is your physical condition?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Me? Yeah, I'm completely fine now! I'm 
sorry for making you worry—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Do not apologize.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You have no need to apologize. If you 
have recovered, that is all that matters.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby... Yeah. ...Yeah, thank you.
